Method of Attack: Bypassing Gatekeeper checks using a specially crafted archive file that lacks the quarantine attribute.
Attack Vector: Archive Utility failing to add quarantine attribute to extracted folders.
Indicators of Compromise: Files or folders extracted from an archive named 'exploit.app.zip' without the 'com.apple.quarantine' attribute.

Method of Attack: Bypassing Gatekeeper checks using a malicious ZIP archive.
Attack Vector: Malicious ZIP archive bypassing Gatekeeper checks.
